name: US Data Privacy
fullName: California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (Cal. Civ. Code §1798.100 et seq.) and CCPA Regulations (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, §7000 et seq.)
publisher: State of California; California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA)
version: CCPA as amended by CPRA (operative 1 Jan 2023); CPPA regulations on cybersecurity audits, risk assessments and ADMT approved 22 Sep 2025, effective 1 Jan 2026 with phased compliance dates
appliesTo: For-profit businesses doing business in California that meet CCPA thresholds, used here as the anchor for obligations common to US state comprehensive privacy laws.
note: Anchored on California; other state laws (e.g. Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Texas) share these themes but differ in thresholds, rights and deadlines, and ADMT/risk-assessment/cyber-audit obligations phase in from 2026–2028.
